<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/v1/services/{service_id}/providers/{provider_id}/conferencing"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Remove the conferencing configuration for a service provider. Succeeds even
when no conferencing is currently configured.

Returns a 404 when the service or provider does not exist, the provider is
not assigned to the service, or the service provider is not accessible to
the current actor.
